columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Hard session-budget governance with pause-and-resume semantics for managed Digital Employees
columns.title_zh: 面向托管数字员工的硬 Session 预算与暂停—恢复治理
columns.source: Anthropic Claude Managed Agents release notes — session budgets
columns.source_zh: Anthropic Claude Managed Agents 发布说明 — Session Budgets
columns.researchQuestion: How should a managed Digital Employee runtime enforce a hard per-session spend budget, pause work without losing lifecycle ownership, resume after an authorized budget change, and inherit the same constraint across deployment-created sessions?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: 托管数字员工 Runtime 应如何执行每个 Session 的硬支出预算，在不丢失生命周期所有权的情况下暂停工作，并在授权调整预算后恢复，同时让 Deployment 创建的 Session 继承同一约束？
columns.reason: This is the strongest bounded Digital Employee object in the same-day pool because it turns cost authority into explicit runtime state: a hard budget stops new model requests, moves the session into a pause condition, permits controlled resume, and can be inherited by deployment-created sessions. The source is first-party and the question is directly testable as a Digital Employee lifecycle and authority boundary.
columns.reason_zh: 这是同日 Signal Pool 中边界最清晰的数字员工对象：它把成本权限转化为显式 Runtime 状态——硬预算阻止新模型请求，使 Session 进入暂停条件，并允许受控恢复，还可由 Deployment 创建的 Session 继承。来源为一手官方资料，问题可直接转化为数字员工生命周期与权限边界测试。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the exact budget-enforcement point, budget_reached pause semantics, authorized resume behavior, deployment inheritance, observability, edge cases and stated product limits. Do not analyze or draft an article during Reading.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查预算强制执行点、budget_reached 暂停语义、授权恢复行为、Deployment 继承、可观测性、边界情况与产品声明限制；Reading 阶段不得分析或撰写文章。
columns.proposedCategory: Digital Employee Runtime Budget and Lifecycle Governance

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Centrally managed model policy that forces automatic review and permission downgrades
columns.title_zh: 集中管理模型策略驱动的强制自动 Review 与权限降级
columns.researchQuestion: What enterprise control-plane architecture is implied when a centrally managed model identity can force an automatic reviewer, downgrade execution permissions, reject incompatible overrides, and preserve the review requirement across thread and MCP approval boundaries?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: 当集中管理的模型身份可以强制指定自动 Reviewer、降低执行权限、拒绝不兼容 Override，并让 Review 要求跨 Thread 与 MCP Approval 边界持续有效时，企业控制平面需要怎样的架构？
columns.reason: This is the strongest Industry Architecture object because one maintainer change exposes policy distribution, model eligibility, reviewer assignment, permission shaping, override rejection and cross-lifecycle enforcement as a single control-plane mechanism. It is more architecturally informative than a narrow product setting and is backed by merged implementation evidence.
columns.reason_zh: 这是最强的行业架构对象：一个已合并维护者变更把策略分发、模型资格、Reviewer 指派、权限整形、Override 拒绝及跨生命周期强制执行暴露为同一控制平面机制，比单一产品设置更具架构信息量，并有可复现实现证据。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the auto_review configuration surface, protected-session permission downgrade, incompatible override handling, thread lifecycle persistence, MCP approval paths, tests and compatibility boundaries. Do not perform Research Analysis during Reading.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查 auto_review 配置表面、受保护 Session 权限降级、不兼容 Override 处理、Thread 生命周期持续性、MCP Approval 路径、测试与兼容边界；Reading 阶段不得执行 Research Analysis。
columns.proposedCategory: Enterprise Agent Control Plane and Review Policy

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Versioned gRPC host protocol for agent code-mode sessions and executions
columns.title_zh: 面向 Agent Code Mode Session 与执行的版本化 gRPC Host Protocol
columns.researchQuestion: How should an agent runtime expose code-mode session creation, execution, waiting, tool callbacks, notifications and content results through a versioned host protocol while keeping lifecycle, compatibility and observable failure boundaries explicit?
columns.researchQuestion_zh: Agent Runtime 应如何通过版本化 Host Protocol 暴露 Code Mode 的 Session 创建、执行、等待、Tool Callback、通知与内容结果，同时保持生命周期、兼容性与可观测失败边界明确？
columns.reason: This is the strongest Open-source Engineering object because it defines a concrete versioned runtime boundary rather than an isolated fix: protobuf contracts cover session management, executions, waits, callbacks, notifications and results, with generated Rust client/server bindings and build targets. The mechanism is directly inspectable and reproducible.
columns.reason_zh: 这是最强的开源工程对象，因为它定义的是具体、版本化的 Runtime 边界而非孤立修复：Protobuf Contract 覆盖 Session 管理、执行、等待、Callback、通知与结果，并包含生成的 Rust Client/Server Binding 与构建目标，机制可直接检查与复现。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the protobuf schema, session and execution lifecycle, wait semantics, callback and notification contracts, error/cancellation behavior, version compatibility, generated bindings, build targets and tests. Do not draft implementation guidance during Reading.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查 Protobuf Schema、Session 与 Execution 生命周期、Wait 语义、Callback 与 Notification Contract、错误/取消行为、版本兼容、生成 Binding、构建目标与测试；Reading 阶段不得撰写实现建议。
columns.proposedCategory: Agent Runtime Protocol and Host Boundary
